title: Hand off one tool step without a dotted-line graph node
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads a lifecycle_case plan (`replace`) for: Hand off one tool step without a dotted-line graph node. He performs product step `lifecycle_case` and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on each scenario.
implementation: `LifecycleExtensionRegistry` via Config `get_lifecycle_extension_registry`, dispatched at tool/graph boundaries. Product CLI verb `lifecycle_case` (`mechaharness.cli_lifecycle_case`) with `case: replace` plans.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario(s) `lifecycle_extension_replace.yaml` drive product verb `lifecycle_case` with plan path(s); hard expects on declared observation keys.
